name: EASTER HYMN
source: Open Hymnal Project ABC score (after Church Praise, 1885); the harmony in the same source confirms each melody note.
reviewNotes: High. Check bar 1: 'is' drops back to the low doh (C E G C, then up to F for 'ris'n'), as in this source and its harmony. The Alleluia melismas: 'Al-' five notes (seven in the last line), 'le-' two, 'lu-' two.
